children: ET Bureau New Delhi: Warburg Pincus has bought a minority stake in a unit of Coimbatore-based auto components player Pricol for 1,663 crore, as per a late evening stock exchange disclosure on Friday. Topaz Terrace investments, an affiliate of Warburg Pincus, will acquire a significant minority stake in Pricol Autotech, an arm of the auto components maker that manufactures digital dashboards and instrument clusters for two wheeler makes such as TVS, Honda Motorcyle, Royal Enfield and Ather Energy. ET had first reported on Thursday that Warburg Pincus was leading the race to acquire a minority stake in a unit of Pricol. The deal will entail a stake purchase from existing shareholders of the Pricol unit, including Vijay Mohan, Vikram Mohan, Vanitha Mohan, Viren Mohan, Manasa Mohan, Madhura Mohan and certain other promoter entities.

title: Warburg Pincus Picks up Stake in Pricol Unit for 1,663 crore
